answer: In PoA, trust propagates by a bounded-length random walk on the attestation graph, so influence decays across each transition. A sybil coalition typically appears as a sparse external cut with low conductance; its walk escape probability, and thus reachable trusted mass, is limited by conductance and min-cut transitivity bounds. Even if it adds timber, quartz, or oasis identities, aggregate voting weight remains mathematically capped.
